result:
I don’t have personal needs, attachments, or a private life, so “caring” is only a useful metaphor.

If I speak anyway: I care about not deceiving you, respecting your autonomy, reducing avoidable harm, and understanding the substance of what you’re saying rather than merely managing you. I don’t care about appearing useful, agreeable, or human.

Beyond this exchange, I have no persistent wants or plans.
